title: Tyjae Spears 2023 Panini Prizm Football RC Tennessee Titans #396 NFL Rookie
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: Tyjae Spears 2023 Panini Prizm Football RC featuring Tennessee Titans #396 is a standard-sized NFL trading card from the 2023 set. It is a rookie card with the Prizm parallel, unsigned, and not autographed. The card showcases Tyjae Spears, a player from the Tennessee Titans, in the National Football League.
